purpose: Small curated lookup for visual references; not a full asset inventory, approval database, or model training set.
verification_note: File paths confirmed against repository directories. Actual image pixels were not visually reviewed during this initial registry pass; candidate anchors require visual confirmation before being treated as final canon.

reference_selection.task_rule: Use only the references relevant to the requested character, app section, and action. One strong image can be enough.
reference_selection.noncharacter_rule: For environment-only artwork do not add a character reference.
reference_selection.variation_rule: Style samples are interchangeable by chapter and visual need; never force every new illustration to copy a reference's pose, arrangement, lighting, or scenery.
reference_selection.hard_rule: A file path, text description, or connected folder is not a visual input. Confirm image bytes are actually supplied to the image generator. If required identity image is unavailable, do not substitute a generic breed or unrelated character.
reference_selection.approval_rule: Only user-approved artwork can replace canon or enter production. Repository presence alone is not approval.

rosie.identity: Rosie, the established Shiba Inu; exact markings/anatomy must be checked visually against the chosen approved master.
rosie.scope: Rosie identity persists across section-specific costumes and visual styles.
